commands:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomaps/work
MAIN_SHA=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
WORK_SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
cd "$REPO"
git fetch origin main work/photomap-straighten-20260912 --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = "$WORK_SHA"
echo '=== REMOTE TAGS MATCHING PREDEPLOY ==='
git ls-remote --tags origin 'refs/tags/pre-photomap-audit-20260913*' || true
echo '=== PI CONNECTIVITY / REPO ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo IPS=$(hostname -I); cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; echo BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo STATUS_BEGIN; git status --porcelain; echo STATUS_END; git remote -v | sed -n "1,2p"'
echo '=== PI RUNTIME STATUS ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; ./scripts/serverctl.sh status || true; echo ---TUNNEL---; ./scripts/serverctl.sh tunnel-status || true; echo ---LISTEN---; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(:8000|:5174|:80|:443)" || true; echo ---PROCESSES---; pgrep -af "server\.py|cloudflared|nginx|caddy" || true; echo ---ENV_BIND---; if [ -f .env ]; then grep -E "^(PHOTOMAP_SERVER_HOST|PHOTOMAP_SERVER_PORT|PHOTOMAP_PUBLIC_SITE_URL)=" .env || true; fi; echo ---TUNNEL_INGRESS---; if [ -f .cloudflared/config.yml ]; then grep -E "^[[:space:]]*(hostname|service):" .cloudflared/config.yml || true; fi; if [ -f /etc/cloudflared/config.yml ]; then grep -E "^[[:space:]]*(hostname|service):" /etc/cloudflared/config.yml || true; fi'
echo '=== PI LOCAL CURLS ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; IP=$(hostname -I | awk "{print \\$1}"); printf "loopback_health="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health || true; printf "lan_health="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 "http://$IP:8000/health" || true'
